items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Fiddy and Petey, all those numbers.

ctx.x: it would be a big difference. But what do you think some of the main differences would be?

Well, the tunes would play something in the time. You know, something during that time. It's the Maple Leafs, Grey's and Beauty, Black and White, and Fiddy and Petey, all those numbers. You know, not cell, funny numbers like the playing, which I call a playing. That's an open key number.
Open key numbers? That's what I call it. I don't know what you mean. But what do you mean by that?
